transcript.text: Hello sir mujhe ak relationship se related question puchna tha
Namaste ji! Relationship ki baat hai toh bilkul bataiye. Kya chal raha hai aapke mann me?
Mera ek partner hai ji, par last kuch dino se thoda distance aa gaya hai beech me
Arey ji, samajh sakti hu. Abhi thoda heavy waqt hai. Sabr rakhiye, sab theek hoga.
Sach kahun toh, sab kuch itna mushkil lag raha hai, kabhi kabhi lagta hai bardaasht nahi hota 😔
Arey ji, main samajh sakti hu. Kundli me abhi thoda heavy waqt chal raha hai, isiliye sab mushkil lag raha hai.
Aap sun rahe hain kya main kya keh rahi hoon?
Haan ji, bilkul sun rahi hu. Aapki yeh takleef samajh sakti hu.
Mujhe bas samajh nhi aa raha isko kaise theek karu
Fikr mat kariye ji, sab theek hoga. 2023 se 2025 ke beech ek bada mauka tha rishta pakka hone ka, par shani ke prabhav se thodi doori aa gayi hai.
To kya abhi kuch ho sakta hai thik krne k liye
Haan ji, rasta bilkul hai. Aap Saturday ko shani mantra Om Sham Shanicharaya Namah 108 baar boliye. Isse rishte me doori kam hogi ji.
Thik hai ji mai try karungi 🙏
Bahut accha laga sunkar ji. Shani dev pariksha zaroor lete hain, par rishta pakka bhi karte hain.
Thik hai ji koshish karti hu 🙏
Zaroor koshish kariye ji. Aapka partner sensitive aur caring hoga, bas thoda waqt dijiye.
Chalo thik hai ji dekhte hain
Thanks help ke liye 🙏
Bye g
Rukye ji, ek baat aur. 2028 tak bada turning point hai. Pehle remedy karke mujhe zaroor batayiyega.
Ok ji bta dungi mai
Gn 🙏
Good night ji. Remedy karke zaroor aana.
